title.justification: The paper introduces novel quaternion recurrent neural networks (QRNN) and quaternion long-short term memory neural networks (QLSTM).
title.quote: We propose a novel quaternion recurrent neural network (QRNN), alongside with a quaternion long-short term memory neural network (QLSTM)...

analysis.description: The paper introduces quaternion recurrent neural networks (QRNN) and their extension, quaternion long-short term memory neural networks (QLSTM), which utilize quaternion algebra to handle multi-dimensional features such as those used in speech recognition. These networks achieve competitive results with fewer parameters compared to conventional RNNs and LSTMs.

type.justification: The paper presents empirical results comparing the quaternion neural networks to traditional models in tasks like automatic speech recognition.
type.quote: We show that both QRNN and QLSTM achieve better performances than RNN and LSTM in a realistic application of automatic speech recognition.
